sources.title: Hemmingway — the AI that writes when you don't want to
sources.snippet: The AI that feels human. Hemmingway-1 is our own 27B parameter model. It writes like a person, not a machine, and it is built for talking to people and for writing beautifully. In our tests it sounds more human than any model we put next to it, at a fraction of their size. Hemmingway-1 model card

sources.title: Hemmingway-1: The 27B Open Model Trained to Write Like a Person
sources.snippet: Hemmingway-1 is a 27B Apache-2.0 model tuned for everyday writing that claims to beat GPT-6 Astra and Kimi K3 on human-likeness tests.
